# Feature Brief

## Summary

Describe the user problem and selected scope without duplicating requirements.

## Read Order And Authority

1. [requirements.md](requirements.md): numbered requirements and acceptance.
2. [design.md](design.md): current design, decisions and validation strategy.
3. [tasks.md](tasks.md): stable task IDs, dependencies, acceptance and evidence.
4. [traceability.md](traceability.md): delivery coverage when needed.
5. [verification.md](verification.md): results, limits and readiness gates.

## Status

Record the next safe action and unresolved decisions. A brief is optional and
must not become a second requirements source. Label legacy inputs historical.
